questions.stem: Explain how bottom-up tabulation differs from memoisation in dynamic programming and provide an example.
markingGuide: Explanation of bottom-up tabulation as an iterative approach.
Comparison with memoisation as a recursive approach.
Example of bottom-up tabulation, such as computing Fibonacci numbers iteratively.
questions.explanation: Bottom-up tabulation builds solutions iteratively from base cases, often reducing space complexity. In contrast, memoisation uses recursion and stores results. An example is computing Fibonacci numbers iteratively, storing only the last two values.
